articles.title: 'I have done my duty': Harmanpreet Kaur steps down as India captain
articles.summary: India women’s captain Harmanpreet Kaur has stepped down from captaincy in all formats, bringing an end to her stint as the team’s leader. Harmanpreet said the decision was not easy but felt she had fulfilled her responsibility as captain..

Bengaluru gym trainer ‘strangled’ by collagues at anniversary party
articles.summary: M Nandan, a 25-year-old gym trainer, was allegedly assaulted to death after a quarrel among trainers. The incident occurred at a flat in Kempapura following the gym's anniversary celebration.

219 box turtles rescued after hundreds were dumped near New Jersey river
articles.summary: The Mercer County Wildlife Center is diligently working to rehabilitate 219 abandoned box turtles, found near Cranford, New Jersey, back in July. A significant rescue operation was launched after these turtles were discovered by the riverbank.

articles.title: Soldiers looking for land mines in South Korea have found the country's oldest gun dating back to more than 600 years
articles.summary: In a fascinating search for hidden landmines, South Korean troops discovered a small bronze gun buried beneath the earth. Dubbed a Hwangja Hwatong, this artifact dates back to the 14th or 15th century.

articles.title: Five Indiana engineering students built a 12-hour wearable that helps visually impaired users detect obstacles beyond a cane or guide dog
articles.summary: Rose-Hulman students have developed a remarkable wearable device tailored for visually impaired individuals. This innovative headgear employs advanced sensors to identify surrounding obstacles, providing users with haptic feedback.

articles.title: Mahakavya producer hints at negative marketing by Ranbir Kapoor's Ramayana team
articles.summary: 'Mahakavya Shri Ramayan Katha' producer Prakash Mahobiya has alleged that negative marketing affected the film’s box office performance and claimed that YouTubers and influencers were spreading misinformation about the movie. Without directly naming Nitesh Tiwari’s 'Ramayana', he referred to a big-budget film on the same subject.

articles.title: Rashmika Mandanna on trolls: 'I can’t fake it to make someone happy'
articles.summary: Rashmika Mandanna discussed handling online criticism regarding her personality and public behavior. She emphasized the importance of staying true to herself and spreading positivity.

articles.title: Ewan Mitchell eyed to play James Bond villain?
articles.summary: Ewan Mitchell, known for his role in 'House of the Dragon', is emerging as a contender for a Bond villain. The ongoing search for the next James Bond follows Daniel Craig's departure from the franchise.

articles.title: 'Ramayana' actor Sunil Lahri warns of drought and shortages
articles.summary: Actor Sunil Lahri is raising awareness about the need to conserve essential resources amid drought concerns. He addressed the potential impacts of the El Nino phenomenon on rainfall, agriculture, and resources.
